translation.name: An it jilchith cau cʼal i Ajatic Jesucristo

book.name: APOCALIPSIS
book.title: Jahua’ tejhua’methanchat an t’ocat inic Juan

content: Am bo’chilab ángel in juchuy an trompeta ax in chal jaye, ani u tsu’u ijcan ti tsabal jun a ot. Nixe’ xa ot in le’ quin ulu abal jaja’ pel i pojcax ángel. In chal i llave abal quin japiy jun ti hua’ats i paxq’uith luputh jol in c’uajattal an teneclabchic.
Tam tin japits an jol, tam ti cale i pau ejtil max u calel al i lej pulic horno. Ma yic’utsinalits an eb ani a q’uicha yabats tajc’anal c’al yantalam i pau.
Ani cale ti al nixe’ xi pau i pactha’ ts’ili’chic, ani pa’iy teje’ tsabal. In cua’al in tsap ti othnax ejtil an thiniy.
Uchanchic yab quin othna’ an ts’ojol ni an te’lomchic teje’ tsabal, expith quin othna’ an inicchic axi yab pel in c’al a Dios, yab ts’o’math im piq’uib c’al in ts’o’maxtal a Dios.
Ca xe’tsin ti othnax c’al an inicchic bo’ a its’, ani yab quin tsemtha’chic. Ca yajchiquiyat an inicchic ejtil tam ts’ic’ath c’al i thiniy.
Tam quim baju a q’uicha ca t’ajchin antsana’ an inicchic, tamna’ ne’ets quin aliy jant’ini’ ta ca tsemets. Ne’ets quin lej le’ ca tsemets, ani yab ne’ets quin ejtou ca tsemets.
Am pactha’ ts’ili’chic u tsu’tab ejtil max i bichim ts’ejcathits ca eyentha c’al an soldadochic. Tin oc’ in cua’al ejtil i corona oro, ani in hual ejtil in hual i inic.
In xi’il ejtil in xi’il i uxum ani in camab ejtil in camab i tsoj.

Eleb tin ichich in cua’al ejtil i thiboc’lab. U ats’a’ lej cahuith in t’ajalchic c’al in ocob ejtil max ca huat’c’an jun athic yantalam i carrochic quininil c’al i bichim axi athithil ne’ets c’al am pejextalab.
In hueu ejtil in hueu an thiniy axi lej ts’ic’ax. C’al in ts’ic’axtal ne’ets quin othna’ an inicchic bo’ a its’.

Abatnab nixe’ xi pactha’ ts’ili’chic c’al i pojcax ángel axi pel i ts’ale c’al nixe’ xi teneclabchic axi al an luputh jol. Im bij ti hebreo cau pel a Abadón, ani ti griego cau a Apolión. A Apolión in le’ quin ulu pel an q’uibethom c’al an inicchic.
Talits an oc’ox c’ac’ath yajchictalab ani q’uibele tsab i yajchictalab.
An acacchilab ángel in juchuy an trompeta ax in chal, ani u ats’a’ cale i cau al xi tse’lam i its’am ti al nixe’ xi ts’acnaxtalab oro jun tu binab i ts’acchixtalab tin tamet a Dios.
Uchan an acacchilab ángel: ―Hua’ats tse’ i ángelchic huic’at ti al am pulic itse’ Eufrates, ca hualca’.

Tam hualcajits axi tse’ i ángel. Ja’its an lej pejath hora in aychi ca hualca abal quin tsemtha’ tin oxchil tin yanel an inicchic. An tamub, ani a its’, ani an q’uicha, ani an hora a Dios im pejamalits patal.
In olchin abal hua’ats tin yanel tsab i bo’ inic i millonchic i soldado punat al nixe’ xi bichimchic.

Antsana’ tin tsu’binchi a Dios ejtil max in huachbil c’al nixe’ xi bichimchic ani an soldadochic punat. Eleb tin ichich an soldadochic in cua’al i thiboc’lab tsacni’ ani yaxu’ ani manu’. In oc’ am bichimchic ejtil in oc’ i tsoj. Calel tin hui’chic i c’amal ani i c’alul ani i pau.
Xi oxlam pel i yajchictalab c’al ta ca tsemtha tin oxchil tin yanel an inicchic axi c’uajate tsabal.
In cua’al in tsap ti tsemthom tin hui’ ani tin hueu. In hueu ejtil in oc’ i tsan ani jats in othnaxnal c’al an inicchic.

An inicchic axi jilc’on ejate c’al nixe’ xi yajchictalab yab tsemets, bel yab jic’tson c’al in hualab. Bel yab in jila’ in hualabchic. Bel c’ac’nax c’al i quithab espíritu, ani bel in diosnal i thulcuts axi i oro, ani i plata, ani i bronce, ani i te’, ani i t’ujub. An thulcuts ax in diosnal yab ejat. Yab u tsu’ux, ani yab u ots’ox, ani yab u belal.
Cum yab jic’tsonal c’al in hualab jaxtam yab in jila’ an hualabtalab. Bel xe’etse ti tsemthom inic, ani ti thiman, ani ti juncunal c’al axi yab in q’uimathil, ani ti cue’chic.
